note: Public R.E.V 2.5.1 (the esp32s3 file 6e6d698c44c5) re-quantized for the ESP32-S31 by ESP-PPQ (target esp32s31, w8a16, int16_lut_step=-1) from the same trained weights and calibration windows; the classifier head dequantises to exactly the esp32s3 values. The S31 target stores one weight exponent per output channel. int16_lut_step=-1: no int16 LUT, so ESP-DL runs its native int16 Relu and the chip matches the ESP-PPQ simulation bit for bit (the default step-256 LUT is evaluated nearest-neighbour on the chip).
